A small kitchen with big standards

Juniper Table started with a simple idea: cook the food we'd serve our own families, and do it a few blocks from home. Our dough proofs overnight, our sauces start from scratch each morning, and our produce comes from Colorado farms whenever the season allows.

No freezers full of shortcuts, no microwave doing the heavy lifting — just a small team that cares about getting dinner right.

  • Pasta and bread made in-house daily
  • Kids 9 and under eat free on Tuesdays — one free kids meal per adult entrée
  • Vegetarian and gluten-free options on every section
